title: LMMU solar car-park lighting
summary: Design, supply, installation and commissioning of single- and dual-arm commercial solar street lighting at Levy Mwanawasa Medical University.

specs.label: Areas
specs.value: Public hub and academic wing car parks

scope: Supply of solar street lights and poles
challenge: A busy university campus needs safe, well-lit car parks and walkways without adding to grid demand or electricity bills.
solution: Donmac designed and installed off-grid commercial solar street lights in single- and dual-arm configurations, each with its own panel and battery.
outcomes: Safer, well-lit car parks after dark
Lighting that runs independently of the grid
No ongoing electricity cost for the lighting
